7. Follow your healthcare provider's instructions for self-administering injections, and be sure to thoroughly clean the injection site with an alcohol swab before administering the medication.
8. Keep Lovenox out of reach of children and pets, and store it at room temperature, away from moisture and heat.
9. Do not share Lovenox with others, even if they have similar symptoms, as it is a prescription medication with specific dosage and administration instructions.
10. Attend all scheduled follow-up appointments with your healthcare provider to ensure that Lovenox is working effectively and safely for you.
